proposedRecord.name: New York
proposedRecord.licensingAuthorityNote: New York does not license general contractors at the state level; licensing is handled by individual cities and counties (e.g., NYC Department of Buildings). Trade licenses (electrical, plumbing) are also frequently local rather than statewide.

faqs.question: Is there a statewide contractor license in New York?
faqs.answer: No. New York leaves general contractor licensing to individual municipalities, so an out-of-state contractor may need separate approval in each city or county where they plan to work.
